description: Open-source ACE-Step 1.5 music generation model for text-to-music and lyrics-to-song workflows across 50+ languages, with editing routes such as cover generation, repainting, continuation, stem extraction, and vocal-to-BGM conversion.

request.name: route
request.description: ACE-Step operation to run; default text2music.

request.name: lyrics
request.description: Vocal lyrics.

request.name: duration_sec
request.description: Target generated audio duration in seconds; when omitted, ACE-Step falls back to planner/config duration, then 30 seconds.

request.name: language
request.description: Vocal language for lyrics.

request.name: track_name
request.description: Track name used by lego and extract routes.

request.name: complete_track_classes
request.description: Track classes for complete route.

request.name: repaint_start
request.description: Repaint start time in seconds; omitted means the start of the input region.

request.name: repaint_end
request.description: Repaint end time in seconds; omitted means the end of the input region.

request.name: repaint_mode
request.description: Preset repaint blending policy; default balanced.

request.name: repaint_strength
request.description: Repaint strength; default 0.5 when repainting is active.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Diffusion denoising steps; default 8.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Diffusion classifier-free guidance scale; default 1.0.

request.name: use_adg
request.description: Use adaptive diffusion guidance instead of the default projected guidance path when diffusion CFG is active; default false.

request.name: cfg_interval_start
request.description: Start of the normalized diffusion timestep interval where guidance_scale is applied; default 0.0.

request.name: cfg_interval_end
request.description: End of the normalized diffusion timestep interval where guidance_scale is applied; default 1.0.

request.name: seed
request.description: Generation seed for reproducible output; omitted uses a random seed.

request.name: bpm
request.description: Force BPM metadata.

request.name: keyscale
request.description: Force key metadata.

request.name: time_signature
request.description: Force time signature metadata.

request.name: negative_prompt
request.description: Negative prompt.

request.name: instruction
request.description: Route-specific DiT instruction override; omitted uses the route default instruction.

request.name: audio_codes
request.description: Use supplied ACE semantic code text instead of planner generation.

request.name: thinking
request.description: Enable planner thinking to generate music codes and optional metadata; default true, but extract route forces false.

request.name: use_cot_metas
request.description: Let the planner fill missing metadata such as duration, BPM, key, and time signature; default true, but extract route forces false.

request.name: use_cot_caption
request.description: Use the planner caption when building DiT conditioning; default true, but extract route forces false.

request.name: use_cot_language
request.description: Use the planner language metadata when building lyric conditioning; default true, but extract route forces false.

request.name: audio_cover_strength
request.description: Cover strength for cover/edit-style conditioning; default 1.0.

request.name: cover_noise_strength
request.description: Noise strength for cover conditioning; default 0.0.

request.name: shift
request.description: Diffusion timestep schedule shift; default 1.0, but extract route uses 3.0 unless overridden.

request.name: timesteps
request.description: Explicit normalized diffusion timestep schedule; omitted derives the schedule from num_inference_steps and shift.

request.name: lm_temperature
request.description: Planner sampling temperature; default 0.85.

request.name: lm_guidance_scale
request.description: Planner classifier-free guidance scale; default 2.0.

request.name: lm_top_k
request.description: Planner top-k sampling limit; default 0 disables top-k.

request.name: lm_top_p
request.description: Planner nucleus sampling probability; default 0.9.

request.name: lm_repetition_penalty
request.description: Planner repetition penalty; default 1.0.

request.name: sampler
request.description: Diffusion sampler used for denoising; default euler.

request.name: retake_seed
request.description: Optional retake noise seed; -1 clears it. Omitted leaves retake noise unset.

request.name: retake_variance
request.description: Retake noise mixing strength; default 0.0.

request.name: velocity_norm_threshold
request.description: Clamp diffusion velocity updates by norm; default 0.0 disables clamping.

request.name: velocity_ema_factor
request.description: Exponential moving average factor for diffusion velocity updates; default 0.0 disables smoothing.

request.name: repaint_crossfade_frames
request.description: Direct repaint latent-boundary crossfade length in latent frames; default 10, or derived from repaint_mode and repaint_strength when those presets are used.

request.name: repaint_injection_ratio
request.description: Direct fraction of diffusion steps that inject source latents for repainting; default 0.5, or derived from repaint_mode and repaint_strength when those presets are used.

request.name: noise_path
request.description: F32 noise override file for deterministic source encoding, initial diffusion noise, and SDE or retake noise schedules.

request.name: flow_edit_morph
request.description: Status: parsed for text2music, but not usable because the flow-edit diffusion overlay is not implemented.

request.name: dcw_enabled
request.description: Status: experimental dynamic-cfg wavelet path; keep disabled unless validating that path.

request.name: dcw_mode
request.description: Dynamic-cfg wavelet correction band mode; default double.

request.name: dcw_scaler
request.description: Dynamic-cfg wavelet low-band or pixel correction scale; default 0.05.

request.name: dcw_high_scaler
request.description: Dynamic-cfg wavelet high-band correction scale used by double mode; default 0.02.

request.name: dcw_wavelet
request.description: Wavelet basis used by dynamic-cfg wavelet correction; default haar.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Shared ACE-Step weight storage type; default native.

session.name: dit_weight_type
session.description: DiT weight storage type; defaults to weight_type, with f16 promoted to bf16.

session.name: planner_weight_type
session.description: Planner LM weight storage type; defaults to weight_type.

session.name: text_encoder_weight_type
session.description: Text encoder weight storage type; defaults to weight_type.

session.name: vae_weight_type
session.description: VAE weight storage type; defaults to weight_type.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release staged runtime graphs after each request; default false.

load.name: dit_variant
load.description: DiT variant inside the model package; default acestep-v15-turbo.
